purpose: Define how FOSS Atlas can safely monitor project updates without blindly replacing verified catalog data.

automatic_safe: Official release date added or corrected
Official download URL changed with confirmed redirect
Official source URL changed with confirmed project ownership

verification_requirements.version_update: Only update the displayed stable version automatically when an authoritative official release source confirms it.
verification_requirements.auditability: Every automated change should record timestamp, old value, new value and source URL in the future update log.
